subject.title: [Bug] Silent fail-open when Tailscale interface binding fails on gateway start

question: Should an explicit `gateway.bind: "tailnet"` remain a documented best-effort fallback to loopback, or become an exact-bind contract that fails startup when the Tailscale address is unavailable?
rationale: The public docs promise Tailscale-IP-only behavior, but current source explicitly documents and implements loopback fallback; changing this shipped fallback affects availability and operator expectations even though it improves configuration transparency.

options.title: Fail explicit tailnet startup
options.body: Reject unavailable explicit tailnet binds with an actionable error while preserving loopback behavior for default, auto, and Tailscale Serve paths.

options.title: Keep fallback with warning
options.body: Continue loopback-only startup but emit a prominent warning and runtime status showing that the requested tailnet listener was not established.

recommendation.title: Fail explicit tailnet startup
recommendation.body: Reject unavailable explicit tailnet binds with an actionable error while preserving loopback behavior for default, auto, and Tailscale Serve paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available adjacent history is the landing of recent fail-closed non-loopback gateway startup safeguards.
